name: Azeroth Companion
title: Top-Header Hyper Music & Performance Polish
features: Moved HYPER MUSIC on mobile to the main website header, outside the sticky navigation bar and away from bottom-left buttons.
Kept the original PC floating HYPER MUSIC launcher unchanged, with one shared music player and preserved playlists.
Reduced unnecessary initial image work with native lazy loading of offscreen thumbnails and asynchronous image decoding where appropriate.
Optimized newly inserted images without repeatedly rescanning the entire companion layout.
Preserved Blizzard data integrations, Talent Forge, saved builds, studio archive and the existing successful Discord announcement workflow.
